10448.commentary: (PYt) avāpuretan'ti ettha avapubbo ca āpubbo ca puradhātu vivaraṇ'attho'ti āha vivara etan'ti. vakārassa pakāraṃ katvā apāpur'etan'ti'pi pāṭho. amatasaddassa salil'ādayo nivattetuṃ vuttaṃ nibbānassā'ti. ime sattā suṇantū'ti sambandho.
